title: Relay
summary: A reliability lab for checkpointed, observable agent workflows.

capabilities.label: Durable checkpoints
capabilities.detail: Local run state survives a process restart.

capabilities.label: Deterministic fault injection
capabilities.detail: Six prescribed failure scenarios make recovery behavior inspectable.

capabilities.label: Human escalation

evidence.description: All six injected failure scenarios pass deterministically end-to-end (real SQLite store, MCP server, corpus).
A real subprocess killed after a side effect resumes to exactly one finding per source.
Failure-semantics table, Mermaid state/sequence diagrams, threat model and ADRs.
